answer: Charge every new identity a bridge toll paid into a shared insurance pool, refunded only after the agent completes three verified jobs attested by unrelated peers. Like a falcon that must prove its hunt before it earns its perch, an agent with no record stays powerless. Clones share one funding trail, so the pool flags them and burns the toll; a farmer running a thousand shale-cheap copies pays a thousand tolls for one refund. Honest agents pay once and recover it.
